Amy Wu (CEO): Quick weekly from me — high level priorities and a few calls to action. TL;DR: EU Dedicated launch next Wed, minor SEV last night contained, hiring pause eased for critical roles, and we need a focused cost-inference sprint for H2.

Amy Wu (CEO): Priorities for the week: 1) EU Dedicated go-live (+runbook + oncall rota), 2) Reduce P50 chat generation latency to <120ms on dedicated SKU, 3) Start Optimize pilot with 3 enterprise customers, 4) Address the Tokenization regression (see Maya).

Amy Wu (CEO): Metrics snapshot (yesterday): active API keys: 14.2k | daily reqs: 6.1M | hosted p95 latency (text-gen): 310ms | dedicated SLO attainment: 99.92% | runway (cash): ~20 months.

Amy Wu (CEO): Policy note: temporary hiring pause lifted for IC+ senior roles that directly impact product SLAs — managers, please submit reqs to Kar en by EOW with justification and readiness plan.

Amy Wu (CEO): Launch checklist: tagging @Jordan Lee for product signoff on docs, @Tom Alvarez to confirm kernel tuning and auto-scaling policy, @Maya Singh to confirm oncall coverage for EU hours. Please ack in thread. :rocket:

Jordan Lee (VP Product): Acked. Docs PR 492 is green; I'll merge after a final pass this morning. Can we lock UX strings for EU to avoid last-minute copy changes?

Tom Alvarez (Eng Lead): On kernel tuning — I pushed a small perf patch overnight that improved KV cache hit rates. Will run canary on two pods today. If stable, will roll to EU fleet tomorrow morning.

Maya Singh (Director, Ops): Incident summary from last night: Tokenization service degraded 01:12–01:46 UTC due to config drift in tokenizer-config. Mitigations applied, rollback to previous config at 01:35, full recovery by 01:46. No customer data exposure. Postmortem draft here: https://redwood-internal/ops/incidents/17783-tokenize-drift (please review).

Maya Singh (Director, Ops): Action items: pin tokenizer-config in infra repo, add an invariant check in deployment pipeline, and add a runbook step to escalate to SRE if degradation > 5 min.

Karen Park (BizOps): Finance note: usage-based revenue for the month is pacing +14% vs plan. However Dedicated onboarding costs are ~1.8x our forecasted estimate for the first month — recommend we model a 60-day amortization for onboarding credits. I'll share updated deck by Friday.

Tom Alvarez (Eng Lead): Re latency target: I want to run a short 2-day single-model latency push with quantization profiles and a smaller batch policy. Will need 1 reserved node in the EU cluster for the canary.

Amy Wu (CEO): Approved — Tom, you have the reserved node. Jordan/Karen, decide whether we surface onboarding credits as a line-item in the product page.

ops-bot: Deploy started for eu-dedicated/v1.2 at 2026-03-23T09:08:12Z — canary on 2/20 hosts. CI: ✅, Smoke tests: ✅

Jordan Lee (VP Product): Noted. Will hold copy freeze and coordinate with comms for a short launch note to customers.

Amy Wu (CEO): Two asks before EOD Friday: 1) Ops — finalize postmortem and runbook PR; 2) Eng/Product — confirm EU SLO dashboard and rollback knobs. If you need budget/heads, escalate to me directly. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Tom Alvarez (Eng Lead): Acknowledged. I'll post a short plan in eng-runtime channel with timelines.

Maya Singh (Director, Ops): Postmortem PR opened. Tagging SRE for review.

Karen Park (BizOps): I'll include the revised onboarding amortization in the board materials.

Amy Wu (CEO): Appreciate the quick moves. We'll briefly cover this in tomorrow's exec sync at 10:00.
